units.source_text: 关于那个莫可挽回的浮舟，他还是不能忘怀，

en.t: He still could not forget Ukifune, whom he had lost beyond recall,

units.source_text: 对少将说道：“请让我约略窥看一下她改装后的姿态。”

en.t: and he said to the Lesser Captain, "Please let me have just a brief glimpse of her in her changed attire."

units.source_text: 又责备她道：“这是你以前答应我的，总得践约才是。”

en.t: He also reproached her, saying, "You promised me this before, so you must keep your word."

units.source_text: 少将走进去一看，但见浮舟打扮得端端正正，似乎故意想叫人窥看。

en.t: When the Lesser Captain went in and looked, she saw Ukifune neatly dressed, almost as if she had meant to be glimpsed.

units.source_text: 她身穿淡墨色绫衫，内衬暗淡的萱草色衣服。

en.t: She wore a pale ink-colored figured silk robe, with a subdued daylily-colored garment underneath.

units.source_text: 身材十分小巧，体态玲珑可爱，打扮新颖入时。

en.t: Her figure was very petite, graceful and lovely, and her dress was fresh and fashionable.

units.source_text: 头发末端异常丰丽，好像一把展开的折扇。

en.t: The ends of her hair were exceptionally full and beautiful, like an opened folding fan.

units.source_text: 那端正秀丽的脸庞，化妆得恰到好处，两颊略现红晕。

en.t: Her refined, beautiful face was made up with perfect restraint, and a faint blush showed on her cheeks.

units.source_text: 在佛前做功课时，念珠并不拿在手里，还挂在近旁的帷屏上。

en.t: When she performed her devotions before the Buddha, she did not hold her rosary but left it hanging on a nearby curtain screen.

units.source_text: 那一心不乱地诵经的模样，简直可以入画。

en.t: The sight of her chanting the sutras with complete concentration was worthy of a painting.

units.source_text: 少将每次看到她这模样，总是十分替她惋惜，眼泪流个不住。

en.t: Whenever the Lesser Captain saw her like this, she pitied her deeply and could not stop her tears.

units.source_text: 设想对她怀着恋慕之心的中将看见了，更不知何等感慨。

en.t: If the Lieutenant General, who loved her, were to see her, one could scarcely imagine how moved he would be.

units.source_text: 大约此时正是适当机会，少将便把纸隔扇钩子旁边的一个洞指给中将看，

en.t: Thinking this was probably the right moment, the Lesser Captain showed the Lieutenant General a hole beside the hook of the paper sliding screen,

units.source_text: 又将阻碍视线的帷屏等拉开。

en.t: and also pulled aside the curtain screens and other things that blocked the view.

units.source_text: 中将向洞中窥探了一会，想道：“如此美貌，出我意料之外。

en.t: The Lieutenant General peered through the hole for a while and thought, "Such beauty is beyond anything I expected.

units.source_text: 这真是一个绝代佳人啊！”

en.t: She truly is a matchless beauty!"

units.source_text: 便认为浮舟的出家乃由于他自己的过失，既觉可惜，又觉悔恨，终于不胜悲痛。

en.t: He came to believe that Ukifune had become a nun because of his own fault, and feeling both regret and remorse, he was finally overwhelmed with grief.

units.source_text: 忍无可忍之时，竟像发了疯似的。

en.t: When he could no longer endure it, he seemed almost mad.

units.source_text: 深恐里面听见，立即退出。

en.t: Afraid that those inside might hear him, he withdrew at once.

units.source_text: 他想：“走失了如此美貌的一个女子，难道没有人来寻找？

en.t: He thought, "Could it be that no one has come looking after losing such a beautiful woman?

units.source_text: 例如，某人的女儿逃隐不知去向，某人的女儿厌世出家为尼等等，世间自会纷纷传说……”

en.t: For example, people would surely gossip that someone's daughter had fled and disappeared, or that someone's daughter had renounced the world and become a nun..."

units.source_text: 他反复考虑，莫名其妙。

en.t: He turned it over again and again, but could make no sense of it.

units.source_text: 又想：“如此美貌之人，穿了尼装也并不难看，却反而增添清丽，令人销魂。

en.t: Then he thought, "A woman of such beauty is not diminished even in a nun's robes; rather, they add a pure elegance that steals the soul.

units.source_text: 我还是要设法偷偷地取得此人。”

en.t: Somehow I must secretly make her mine."

units.source_text: 便诚恳地请求妹尼僧，对她说道：“小姐在俗之时，未便与我会面。

en.t: He then earnestly entreated the younger nun and said to her, "When the young lady was still in secular life, it was inconvenient for her to meet with me.

units.source_text: 今已出家为尼，尽可放心地与我明谈了。

en.t: Now that she has become a nun, she may speak openly with me without concern.

units.source_text: 务请如此向她劝导。

en.t: Please be sure to advise her in this way.

units.source_text: 我屡次来访，本来只为不忘令嫒旧谊，今后又添一种新情了。”

en.t: My repeated visits were originally only because I had not forgotten my old bond with your daughter, but now a new feeling has been added."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧答道：“此子孤苦伶仃，我正担心她的将来。

en.t: The younger nun replied, "This child is alone and helpless, and I am worried about her future.

units.source_text: 你能真心不忘旧谊，时时来访，我心不胜欣慰。

en.t: If you truly do not forget the old bond and come to visit often, it will comfort me beyond measure.

units.source_text: 一旦我身亡故，此子实甚可怜呢！”

en.t: If I should die, this child would be truly pitiful!"

units.source_text: 中将听了这话，想见此女对妹尼僧必有密切关系，但不知究竟是谁，还是不得要领。

en.t: Hearing this, the Lieutenant General realized that the woman must be closely connected to the younger nun, but he still could not grasp who she really was.

units.source_text: 便说道：“要当小姐终身的保护人，则我身寿命修短难知，殊不可靠。

en.t: He said, "As for being the young lady's lifelong protector, I cannot know how long my own life will last, so I am hardly reliable.

units.source_text: 但既蒙如此叮嘱，今后我决不变心。

en.t: But since you have entrusted me with this so earnestly, I will never change my heart from now on.

units.source_text: 来此找寻而欲认领的人，果真没有么？

en.t: Is there truly no one who has come here searching for her and wishing to claim her?

units.source_text: 不明底细虽然无须顾虑，但总觉得有些隔阂。”

en.t: Although there may be no need to worry about not knowing the details, I still feel some distance because of it."

units.source_text: 妹尼僧答道：“如果她当俗家人而生活在世间，外人都知道有这个人，

en.t: The younger nun replied, "If she were living in the world as a laywoman and outsiders knew of her existence,

units.source_text: 那么或许如你所说，有人会来寻找。

en.t: then perhaps, as you say, someone might come looking for her.

units.source_text: 但她现已出家为尼，和俗世完全隔绝了。

en.t: But now she has become a nun and is completely cut off from the secular world.

units.source_text: 她本人的志望正是如此。”

en.t: That is exactly what she herself wished."

units.source_text: 中将又作一首诗，叫人转达浮舟：

en.t: The Lieutenant General composed another poem and had someone convey it to Ukifune:
